normalization: Icons have standalone xmlns/viewBox and default 24x24 size; original geometry is retained.
Material font ligatures use official Google SVG paths (wght 400, opsz 24, GRAD 0; fill matches the source).
Tailwind layout classes, disabled-state grayscale/opacity and CSS animation are removed; spinner geometry remains static.
Monochrome artwork uses currentColor; multicolor Google artwork is retained. Facebook desktop blue is retained.
Decorations retain their own viewBox. OTP desktop pitch percentage arc coordinates are converted for its explicit 800x800 viewport.
